name: H-28G Evolution Turret / H-28Q Apex Turret

values.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to his target, or a nearby enemy
a secondary beam attack that charges up over time, which deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit
Up to 3 ''H-28G Evolution Turrets'' can be deployed at a time

values.binNote: KitCooldown formula shows base 20 modified by an unresolved CooldownMultiplierCalculationPart (likely ability haste), matching the wiki's stated recharge of 20 before haste.
No bin row for the H-28Q Apex Turret's 8 second duration exists in the sheet; this ability variant's data (a separate spell entry) is not included in the Q slot's bin listing provided.

mechanics.claim: The turret's stats (damage, health) update continuously to reflect Heimerdinger's current AP, level and ability rank, not just at deploy time.
mechanics.quote: The ''H-28G Evolution Turret's'' stats update every second to reflect rank ups, level ups, and changes in '''Heimerdinger's''' ability power.

mechanics.claim: The turret is a separate pet unit that auto-attacks a nearby enemy independently of Heimerdinger's actions; damage from it is a separate instance from his own abilities.
mechanics.quote: deploys a rapid-fire turret that deals {{as|magic damage}} to his target, or a nearby enemy

mechanics.claim: Deploying a 4th turret destroys the oldest active turret.
mechanics.quote: with those deployed beyond the maximum destroying the oldest one

mechanics.claim: After the R upgrade, the turret becomes a slow-fire Apex Turret with a limited 8 second lifespan instead of lasting until destroyed.
mechanics.quote: '''Heimerdinger''' deploys a ''H-28Q Apex Turret'' at the target location, which lasts for 8 seconds.
